title: XGBoost guides the selection of two experimentally tested spinel catalysts
summary: The authors report that two structural descriptors jointly predict polysulfide conversion and that they experimentally tested two model-nominated spinel oxide catalysts. The compositions differ from the catalyst highlighted in their earlier single-descriptor work.

evidence.tested: The authors report experimental validation of Fe₂CoO₄ and Fe₂NiO₄.
evidence.unknown: The comparison used the indexed abstract and earlier publisher text. Full performance baselines and experimental protocols remain to be checked.
evidence.ai_role: XGBoost was used to predict the descriptors across spinel oxides and nominate candidates for experiments.
